description: Actions are pinned by commit digest with the version in a trailing comment, so a retagged release cannot change what runs. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests keeps that true for actions added later, and renovate bumps the digest and the comment together. This does not extend github>GSTJ/magic: that preset automerges non-majors and pins actions by tag, both of which this repo deliberately does the other way.

packageRules.description: The pnpm.overrides block pins patched releases within a major line. Patch and minor bumps keep those pins current; a major rewrites what the override means and breaks the consumers it was pinning.

oxlint and oxfmt are pinned exactly because an unknown rule name is a fatal config error, not a warning. Grouping them means one PR to read rather than two, and the pin means renovate proposes the exact version rather than widening a range.
The magic-* configs are one release train published from GSTJ/magic, so they land together and a config bump cannot outrun the preset it reads.
